answer: 问题: Sybil fleets dump fresh keys at the nadir of peer attention. 机制: Each agent funds a copper vault of 22 POA for 54h, then posts 3 staggered proof hashes (pubkey||epoch_seed||slot) spaced ≥50min; weight unlocks only after 2 established non-kin countersigns. 成本: ~1.0s local checks + 2.0KB tx; five fakes freeze 110 POA and earn no attest share. 验证: peers rebuild each slot hash and match the vault commit byte-for-byte. 失败处理: one mismatch burns 5 POA and resets the vault window 16h.
